select o.*,oi.*, (oi.quantity * oi.price) as subtotal from order_item oi left join `order` o on o.order_id = oi.order_id
o.is_del = 0 and o.add_time between #{pageQuery.startTimeStamp} and #{pageQuery.endTimeStamp} and o.order_status in (#{pageQuery.orderStatues})
and (oi.product_sn like concat('%',#{pageQuery.keyword},'%') or oi.product_name like concat('%',#{pageQuery.keyword},'%'))
and oi.shop_id = #{pageQuery.shopId}
order by o.add_time order by oi.item_id
asc desc
SELECT DISTINCT oi.product_id FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN `order` o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 5 AND o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.add_time DESC

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(online_paid_amount, 0) + COALESCE(balance, 0)), 0) FROM `order` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND pay_status = 2 AND is_valid = 1 AND order_status IN (1, 2, 5)) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM user_recharge_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1)
